s: Which one among the following has the highest energy?

The colours of visible light are arranged in the order Violet (380–450 nm), Blue (450–495 nm), Green (495–570 nm), Yellow (570–590 nm), Orange (590–620 nm), and Red (620–750 nm). Violet light has the shortest wavelength and the highest frequency (about 688–789 THz), while red light has the longest wavelength and the lowest frequency (about 400–484 THz). In each stage, different wireless technologies can be used to transfer information. The generation of these stages involves the construction of the IoT system and the realization of the components. The perception layer is the lowest layer in the Internet of Things, responsible for sensing and collecting data in the environment. The transport layer is responsible for transmitting the data collected by the perception layer to the network layer for processing. The network layer is responsible for establishing connections and routing data in IoT. At this stage, the network infrastructure of the Internet of Things need to be established, including network architecture, routers, gateways, and servers. The generation of the network layer involves the configuration and deployment of network equipment, as well as the implementation and management of network protocols.
